To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
OCA2 interacts genetically with AP-3, with BLOC-1 and with BLOC-2.

1) The pink-eyed dilution allele is semi-dominant in its effects on coat pigmentation, 2) The pallid allele is epistatic to the pink-eyed dilution phenotype, 3) The pink-eyed allele is a phenotypic enhaner of the cocoa allele, and 4) The pearl allele is a phenotypical enhancer of the cocoa allele.
OCA2 interacts functionally with the protein complexes BOC-1, BOC-2, and BOC-3, as inferred from epistasis experiments on coat color in mice.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of genetic and epigenetic factors that influence the phenotype of coat color and coat pattern in the mouse.
understanding the genetic and biochemical basis of pigmentation in mammals.
the study of the genetic basis of human diseases and their mouse models, with the ultimate goal of understanding their pathogenesis and identifying novel targets for therapy.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
OCA2 is required for the function of BLOC-1 and AP-3, but not BLOC-2.
OCA2 and AP-3, as well as OCA2 and BLOC-1 and BLOC- 2 are functionally linked.
OCA2 and AP-3, but not BLOC-1 and BLOC-3, are functionally related.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

BLOC-1 is the most upstream of the three complexes in the melanosome biogenesis pathway, and that AP-3 is downstream of BLOC-1 and upstream of OCA2, which may be downstream of both BLOC-1 as well as AP-3.

OCA2 is required for the proper trafficking of AP-3, and that BLOC-2 and BLOC-1 are also required for proper AP-3 trafficking, but that OCA2 and BLOC complexes are not required for the trafficking of one another.
OCA2 is required for the normal function of AP-3, and that BLOC-1 and BLOC-1 function in parallel to OCA2 in the trafficking of melanogenic enzymes to melanosomes.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the OCA2 protein, a melanosomal transmembrane protein, interacts with the AP3 protein complex, which has been implicated in melanosome biogenic trafficking.
OCA2, BLOC- 1, and BLOCS-2 function in the same pathway, and that AP-3 and OCA2 function in parallel pathways.
epistasis is a useful tool to infer functional interactions between genes.
